2609.13043.title: Unified CT and MRI Pancreas Segmentation for Label-Efficient Cross-Modality Subregion Transfer
2609.13043.paper_summary: Robust medical image segmentation across imaging modalities is challenging because of large differences in appearance and intensity distributions. Models trained on a single modality often show substantial performance drops when applied to unseen domains. In this work, we develop a unified 3D pancreas segmentation framework that applies domain-adversarial learning to 4,604 heterogeneous CT and MRI scans to learn anatomical representations. A shared nnU-Net encoder-decoder is trained for whole-pancreas segmentation, with a latent domain discriminator encouraging CT-MRI feature alignment. The learned encoder is subsequently transferred to pancreatic head-body-tail segmentation using limited MRI-only subregion annotations. An average Dice score of 87.31% on the in-distribution test set and Dice scores ranging from 84.20% to 88.09% across external OOD datasets were achieved in whole pancreas segmentation. Dice scores of 80.53% on MRI and 83.05% on CT were achieved for downstream subregion segmentation, without using CT subregion annotations. These results demonstrate that a unified anatomical representation can support both cross-modality pancreas segmentation and label-efficient downstream transfer.
2609.13043.paper_summary_zh: 穩健的醫學影像分割在不同影像模態之間具有挑戰性，因為外觀和強度分佈存在很大差異。對於單一模態訓練的模型，在應用於未見領域時，性能往往會顯著下降。在這項工作中，我們開發了一個統一的3D胰腺分割框架，該框架應用了領域對抗學習於4,604個異質的CT和MRI掃描，以學習解剖表示。為整個胰腺分割訓練了一個共享的nnU-Net編碼器-解碼器，並使用潛在領域鑑別器促進CT-MRI特徵對齊。隨後，學習到的編碼器被轉移到胰腺頭-體-尾的分割，使用有限的僅MRI子區域標註。在整個胰腺分割中，在分佈內測試集上達到了87.31%的平均Dice分數，並且在外部OOD數據集上，Dice分數範圍從84.20%到88.09%。在下游子區域分割中，MRI的Dice分數為80.53%，CT的Dice分數為83.05%，且未使用CT子區域標註。這些結果顯示，統一的解剖表示可以支持跨模態的胰腺分割和標籤高效的下游轉移。
